capabilities.camera: best-effort browser BarcodeDetector plus getUserMedia; manual and image/file input always remain available
capabilities.providerCredentials: server-only aladin-books invocation; no provider key or direct provider API request in browser assets
capabilities.providerLinks: https-only allowlisted provider hosts opened through an explicit bookstore-select action
capabilities.nativeParityBoundary: browser-equivalent only; no claim of native camera or barcode scanner parity

privacy.ownerScope: discovery requests reject caller-selected identity and add uses the authenticated owner-scoped lifecycle route
privacy.providerBoundary: browser calls the same-origin route and never receives ALADIN_TTB_KEY

qa.bookstoreSelect: tests/e2e/book-discovery.spec.ts clicks bookstore-select-provider and observes a verified HTTPS popup
